info.title: Elysium Mother ERP
info.description: Generated from the Zod contracts in @elysium/contracts and the routes the API registers. Do not edit by hand: `pnpm api:client` regenerates it and `pnpm check:api-client` fails the build if the committed copy disagrees.

session.name: better-auth.session_token
session.description: Set by Better Auth at sign-in. Mutations additionally require the double-submit token in `x-csrf-token`.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: A client-generated key, 8-255 printable ASCII characters. The response is kept for 24 hours per user and route and replayed on a repeat, so a retry after a lost reply cannot repeat the effect.

Problem.description: RFC 9457 problem details. `code` is the stable value clients branch on.
